issues.descricao: The rules accept any client timestamp for createdAt/updatedAt. They don't require `== request.time` on create, and on update they don't require updatedAt to move forward. The repository does send serverTimestamp(), but the rules don't enforce it, so a modified client can write arbitrary dates.
issues.sugestao: On create, require `createdAt == request.time && updatedAt == request.time`. On update, require `updatedAt == request.time`. If protected tests write fixed timestamps, check them first and adapt only what the spec allows.

issues.descricao: reorderIndicators renumbers only the IDs it is given, as (index+1)*1000. If the caller passes only part of the group, the new values can collide with or interleave with the rest of the group's sortOrder. Ties fall back to ordering by id.
issues.sugestao: Document that `ids` must be the whole group's list, or fetch the group and renumber all of it in the same transaction.

issues.descricao: On an unlocked indicator, changing frequency from single_per_day to multiple_per_day without sending dailyAggregation fails validation. The update doesn't apply the suggested aggregation the way createIndicator does.
issues.sugestao: In updateIndicator, when frequency changes and no aggregation is sent, apply suggestAggregation, or null for single_per_day.

issues.descricao: When the result is numeric, idealRange isn't checked against numeric.min/max or scale.min/max. Abbreviation can also be an empty string.
issues.sugestao: If the spec (4.5) requires the range to fall inside the configured bounds, validate it. Otherwise, write down the decision.
